newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 29,900 slaughter steers and 18,100 heifers; 74,200 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 8 loads or 300 CME cattle delivered to area packing plants, 13,800 formulated and 300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00.
Wk to date - 74,200 Week Ago - 56,000 Year Ago - 31,700
